name: Link Converger
author: samiur6688

sections.description:
Link Converger helps WordPress administrators store and manage important links from the WordPress dashboard sidebar.

Whether you need quick access to documentation, client websites, Git repositories, tutorials, or frequently used resources, Link Converger keeps everything in one convenient location.

Features include:

  • Add unlimited links
  • Edit existing links
  • Delete links
  • View all saved links from a dedicated All Links page
  • Simple and lightweight interface
  • WordPress Coding Standards compliant
  • Translation ready
  • No external libraries or frameworks
sections.installation:
1. Upload the link-converger folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Open Link Converger from the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Start adding your important links.
sections.faq:
Where are my links stored?

Your links are stored in your WordPress site’s database and can be accessed from the Link Converger menu in the WordPress admin sidebar.

Does Link Converger affect my website visitors?

No. Link Converger is an admin-only plugin. It does not display anything on the front end of your website.

Can I store unlimited links?

Yes. The plugin does not impose a limit on the number of stored links.
